The binaries we use here are just the compiled versions of the [curl-impersonate](https://github.com/lwthiker/curl-impersonate) binaries for each system

-   You can follow their [compilation guide](https://github.com/lwthiker/curl-impersonate/blob/main/INSTALL.md) but I couldn't make it work natively on my Mac, so I'm sharing my notes here :)

# Compilation guide:

1.  Follow the steps from the official curl-impersonate installation guide pretty much
2.  During dependencies installation on my Mac, I wasn't able to install `gyp-next` with the `pip3 install gyp-next` command

    -   I had to enable the `--break-system-packages` flag -> `pip3 install --break-system-packages gyp-next`

3.  During the configuration step (`../configure`), enable the `--enable-static` flag -> `../configure --enable-static`

    -   This will make the binaries static, so we can use them without any dependencies/libraries

4.  After the compilation, you will find the final binaries in the `build/curl-{version}/src/` directory

    -   E.g. `build/curl-8.1.1/src/curl-impersonate-ff` for the Firefox version
